vision-manual band3/4 2026-07-27: vision 2026-08-24, ANNUAL minus NINE-MONTH from the filer's OWN two filings, same line, same basis (Rs Lacs, Standalone Parent). Annual 'AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE YEAR ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2011': Total Income (1) = 491,854 = 4,918.54 (net sales 485,040 + other operating income 6,814). Nine-month 'UNAUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE THIRD QUARTER ENDED JUNE 30, 2011': Total Income (1) 9M = 380,740 = 3,807.40 (377,927 + 2,813). Q4 = 4,918.54 - 3,807.40 = 1,111.14 (net sales 1,071.13 + other op 40.01). ★ THE SAME SUBTRACTION VALIDATES ITSELF ON PAT: 9M net profit 13,183 lacs = 131.83, annual 1,200 lacs = 12.00, so Q4 = 12.00 - 131.83 = -119.83 == stored npStd EXACT. Bajaj Hindusthan is a SEPTEMBER-FY filer so its 30-09 filing is the ANNUAL with no quarter column - reading it directly would have been wrong. Convention confirmed en route: the 9M filing's Jun-2011 quarter Total Income 106,198 lacs = 1,061.98 == our STORED 20110630 revStd exactly. Moneycontrol says 1,122.0 and was NOT used.

PAT row 13 = 921.41 lacs = 9.2141 == stored npStd 9.21. Row VII Profit for the year = 2,655.01 lakhs = 26.5501 == stored npStd 26.55. ★ VINTAGE MATTERS HERE MORE THAN USUAL: the company's OWN earlier Mar-2016 filing shows that quarter as 76,745.83 lacs = 767.46 with PAT 3,324.76 = 33.25, because (its notes 8-9) those figures are BALANCING figures that fold in 12 months of the amalgamated Styrolution India Pvt Ltd. Our stored PAT 26.55 matches the RESTATED Ind-AS comparative, so the restated revenue is the matching vintage. Reading the earlier filing would have overstated this cell by ~81%.
